	character_support_trigger = {

			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical

					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							is_in_exile_pool = yes
						}
						is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
					}
					trigger_else = {
						interest_group ?= {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 10
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
					interest_group ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = slaves
			AND = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen

					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_police"

			}
		}

# movement_royalist_absolutist
REPLACE:movement_royalist_absolutist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	law_enactment_radicalism_multiplier = 2.0
	ideology = ideology_gov_absolutist_royalist
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_royalist
		ideology_humanitarian_royalist
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = king_in_parliament_possible
				}
				country_has_voting_franchise = yes
			}
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
				}
			}
			has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					NOT = {
						has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
					}
					NOT = {
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_constitutional
						}
					}
				}
			}
			owner ?= {
				create_political_movement = { type = movement_royalist_constitutional }
			}
		}
	}
	creation_trigger = {
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		country_has_voting_franchise = no
		NOT = {
			any_political_movement = {
				is_political_movement_type = movement_royalist_constitutional
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			c:FRA ?= this
			c:POR ?= this
			c:SPA ?= this
			c:SPC ?= this
			civil_war_origin_country ?= c:FRA
			civil_war_origin_country ?= c:POR
			civil_war_origin_country ?= c:SPA
			civil_war_origin_country ?= c:SPC
		}
		OR = {
			NOT = {c:JAP ?= this}
			has_variable = japan_restoration_complete
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}
	character_support_trigger = {
		bpm_character_is_republican = no
		bpm_character_is_anti_aristocrats = no
		OR = {
			AND = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
					bpm_character_is_authoritarian = yes
					bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
				}
				interest_group ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_monarchy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				interest_group ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_monarchy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_monarchy
						value < approve
					}
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value < approve
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 300
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}
	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_ruler_popularity
		movement_support_low_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_officers
	}
	pop_support_weight = {
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 1
			subtract = state.state_urbanization_rate
			multiply = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = 5
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = farmers
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_shopkeepers_farmers_capitalists
					desc = "BPM_LABOR_CONSCIOUSNESS"
				}
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = capitalists
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_shopkeepers_farmers_capitalists
					desc = "BPM_LABOR_CONSCIOUSNESS"
				}
				desc = "POP_CAPITALISTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = shopkeepers
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_shopkeepers_farmers_capitalists

				}
				desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
			}

			add = {
				value = 6

					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_others
					desc = "BPM_LABOR_CONSCIOUSNESS"

				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = laborers
				bpm_pop_employment_is_rural = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_laborers_machinists
					desc = "BPM_LABOR_CONSCIOUSNESS"
				}
				desc = "POP_LABORERS"
			}
		}

			limit = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_others

		}

				is_pop_type = officers
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_reactionary_movement_others
					desc = "BPM_LABOR_CONSCIOUSNESS"
				}
				desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			value = 1
			subtract = owner.bpm_consciousness_liberal_percent
			desc = "BPM_LIBERAL_CONSCIOUSNESS"

		min = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					NOT = { has_trait = trait_child }
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				add = owner.ruler.popularity
				multiply = 0.01
				add = 1
				min = 0.2
				max = 1.8
				desc = "RULER_POPULARITY"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					has_trait = trait_child
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy

					}

				value = 0.75
				desc = "RULER_IS_CHILD"

					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value <= neutral

		if = {

				}

				}
			}
		}
		interest_group_can_join = {
			bpm_ig_is_anti_democratic = yes
			bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
		}
	}
	secession = {
		possible = {
			always = no
		}
		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
		state_weight = {
			value = 1
			subtract = state_urbanization_rate
			if = {
				limit = { is_capital = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { owner ?= { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy } }
					multiply = 10.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
		forced_tags = {
			BHT = {
				trigger = {
					owner ?= { c:BIC ?= this }
				}
				weight = 1000
			}
		}
	}
	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = { value = bpm_additional_radicalism_factors desc = "bpm_additional_radicalism_factors" }
		owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatocracy
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.5
						desc = "MONARCHY_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				value = 36
				multiply = {
					value = owner.bpm_consciousness_liberal_movement_capitalists_shopkeepers
					desc = BPM_LIBERAL_CONSCIOUSNESS

				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"

# movement_tokugawa_loyalist
REPLACE:movement_tokugawa_loyalist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological
	ideology = ideology_tokugawa_loyalist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_authoritarian
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
			has_variable = japan_emperor_restored
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
	}
	creation_trigger = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
		has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
		OR = {
			c:JAP ?= this
			AND = {
				is_subject = yes
				c:JAP ?= top_overlord
			}
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 1000
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}
	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bakufu
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_autocracy
					value >= neutral
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					has_hierarchic_ideology = yes
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_autocracy
					value >= neutral
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}
	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}
	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_loyalism
		movement_support_ruler_popularity
		movement_support_low_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_officers
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_daimyo_loyalty_high
		movement_support_daimyo_loyalty_low
	}
	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 0.5
			subtract = state.state_urbanization_rate
			multiply = 10
		}
		add = {
			desc = "POP_LOYALISTS"
			value = pop_loyalist_fraction
			multiply = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add = {
				value = 25
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = farmers
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = officers
			}
			add = {
				value = 35
				desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = soldiers
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = peasants
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					NOT = { has_trait = trait_child }
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				owner = {
					random_scope_character = {
						limit = {has_role = bpm_character_role_hog}
						value = popularity
					}
				}
				multiply = 0.01
				add = 1
				min = 0.2
				max = 1.8
				desc = "RULER_POPULARITY"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				owner.ruler ?= {
					has_trait = trait_child
					law_stance = {
						law = law_type:law_autocracy
						value > neutral
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.75
				desc = "RULER_IS_CHILD"
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.2
			max = 0.7
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = wargoal_enforced_by_recognized_power
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.75
				desc = "wargoal_pressed_by_recognized_power_tt"
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			value = 0.5
			add = state.state_daimyo_loyalty
			desc = "LOYALTY_OF_STATE_DAIMYO"
		}
	}
	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}
		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
		state_weight = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					state_daimyo_loyalty_impact_tokugawa > 0
				}
				add = state_daimyo_loyalty_impact_tokugawa
			}
			else = {
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}
	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = { value = bpm_additional_radicalism_factors desc = "bpm_additional_radicalism_factors" }
		owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporate_state
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_theocracy
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							is_enacting_law = law_type:law_corporatocracy
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "MONARCHY_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
					}
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							leader = {
								has_variable = house_tokugawa
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "tokugawa_not_in_government_tt"
					value = 0.25
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
